name: stairwell.chain
notes: Hand-made proof that Stairwell G is reachable (L4 merge). Chain: jump + Up+Seize bar 1 at the apex; Down+Levy it at the apex (recoil hop + mid-air spring); bounce and Down+Seize the spring on the launch frame (a 1-frame window: pressed on f60, taken on f65, the frame after the bounce; one frame earlier takes it before the bounce, one later whiffs); Down+Levy it at the next apex, recoil into bar 2 and Up+Seize it; Down+Levy bar 2 at the apex, Up+Seize bar 3 on the recoil; bounce, drift right, Down+Levy bar 3 at the apex for the last recoil hop onto the G ledge.
